note: v1 had no shorter accepted form than tools.<integration>.org.<connection>.<tool> (see executor.ts's parseToolAddress at v1.6.10: owner and connection are always required segments, there is no tools.<integration>.<tool> shortcut). v2Path is the canonical <appSlug>.<tool> path (what tools.search and the usage log show); v2 is the exact expression an agent writes -- tools.<appSlug>.<tool> when the slug is a valid JS identifier, or tools["<appSlug>"].<tool> otherwise (every slug with a hyphen: atlassian-delivery/product, google-workspace-personal/work, browser-session, proton-mail). Every v1 and v2 call is plain input, no accountId.
